## Production Case Studies

- [Poptin MCP Integration](https://www.poptin.com/mcp): Technical Lead. Architected and led Poptin's first MCP server so AI assistants can orchestrate marketing workflows beyond REST APIs. Stack: PHP, Laravel, MCP, AI Agents, LLM Integration, REST APIs, AWS S3. Published to the official MCP Registry. Repository: [Poptin-MCP](https://github.com/Poptin-LTD/Poptin-MCP)
- [Poptin Campaign Pipeline](https://poptin.com): Senior Backend Engineer. Decoupled SNS webhooks into Redis/Horizon queues and parallel batched delivery. Impact: 46.6% faster campaign completion, 87.4% higher throughput, 35.8% faster batch execution, zero peak-load crashes. Stack: Laravel, AWS SNS/SES, CloudWatch, Redis, Horizon
- [Gerocare Cloud Migration](https://gerocare.org): Lead Software Engineer. Migrated healthcare platform from shared hosting to GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, GCS) with GitHub Actions CI/CD and zero-downtime cutover. Impact: eliminated recurring downtime, ~40% faster load times, zero data loss. Stack: Laravel, Vue.js, GCP, Nginx, Cloudflare
- [Hypetag Ecommerce Backend](https://hypetag.com): Lead Backend Engineer. Cost-aware MySQL full-text search via Laravel Scout and transparent multi-currency checkout with Paystack. Stack: Laravel, MySQL, Scout, DigitalOcean, Cloudinary, Paystack
- [Connect Nigeria Directory Backend](https://connectnigeria.com): Backend Engineer. Safe high-volume spreadsheet import pipeline plus dedicated Meilisearch ranking. Stack: Laravel, MySQL, Meilisearch, Scout, Algolia, ElastiCache, S3, GitLab CI/CD
